author: WP19
summary: New (untracked) chapter summarising the Diagnostics module: build ceiling and runtime mode, metric kinds, resource ids, per-thread rings, recordings and evidence. Almost everything is already on docs/diagnostics.html and the Diagnostics internals page at greater depth; two claims are corrected (CI never builds STATS/FULL; the linked-disabled benchmark case is the Inspector one).

concepts.text: modules/diagnostics is renderer-independent instrumentation (metrics, frame timing, resource metadata, CPU zones, events, recordings) that uses only the C++ standard library, starts no thread and opens no socket; consumers pull snapshots and any transport or UI lives elsewhere.
tokens: It owns no thread, no socket and no renderer dependency

concepts.text: CNA_DIAGNOSTICS is a build-time ceiling: OFF compiles the engine macros to statements that type-check but never evaluate their arguments, STATS adds counters, gauges, frame timing and history and resource metadata, FULL adds hierarchical zones, markers, per-thread event streams and recording/export.

Cost boundary per mode: OFF reaches no state, lock or allocation from the macros; STATS updates are relaxed atomics with a bounded metric scan at frame end and a resource-registry lock on lifetime changes; FULL writes into a fixed per-thread context and merges into the process history only at frame or read boundaries.
tokens: merging into the process history happens at frame boundaries

concepts.text: SetRuntimeMode can lower an enabled build but never raise it above the compiled ceiling; runtime OFF is not build-time OFF, because compiled storage stays allocated and resources created while collection is off are never registered retroactively.

target.evidence: modules/diagnostics/src/Diagnostics.cpp (SetRuntimeMode, resource registration returns 0 in runtime Off)

concepts.note: Internals page: "A resource created during a runtime Off window is never registered, even after the mode returns."

concepts.text: Counters accumulate monotonic work, gauges hold current values and frame counters are exchanged to zero at each completed frame; the engine publishes frame time/FPS, draw, effect, render-target, texture-binding, sprite and voice statistics.
In STATS and FULL every graphics resource gets a stable, process-local, never-reused diagnostic id; the ResourceHandle owns only the metadata record, not the resource.
tokens: ResourceHandle owns a metadata id, not the resource

concepts.text: FULL gives each producer thread a 1,024-record single-producer/single-consumer ring whose zone stack and write index belong to the producer; a consumer merges published records into a 32,768-event process history; a full producer ring drops new events and counts them, and history overwrites of the oldest events are counted too.

Zone tokens must end on their producer thread; duplicate, wrong-thread, out-of-order and over-deep (65th nested) use is contained, counted in malformedZoneCount and reported as an event instead of corrupting the stack.

Recordings copy a bounded set of events and serialize Chrome-trace JSON or the binary CNATRACE form outside producer hot paths; the version-1 provider exposes owned snapshots and cursor-based event reads, and source callbacks run after the registry copied their owners so a source may unregister itself; the core creates no transport or listener.
concepts.note: Internals: "Completion copies the owners first, so a source may unregister itself from Collect without deadlock."

concepts.text: Unit tests exercise mode ceilings, concurrency, overflow and drop accounting, malformed zones, resource lifetime and recording structure, but most are gated at level 1 or 2 and no workflow or preset sets CNA_DIAGNOSTICS, so CI compiles only the two level-independent cases.
tokens: No CI workflow and no configure preset sets CNA_DIAGNOSTICS
concepts.note: The unit implied STATS/FULL paths are covered by compile and unit configurations; no automated configuration builds them.

concepts.text: The benchmark compares OFF, STATS and FULL builds (compiled-out macros included) on one recorded machine; the numbers are regression evidence, not universal budgets; bounded histories overwrite, byte figures are declared or estimated, allocator and container overhead is not claimed, and a runtime re-enable cannot reconstruct missed resource lifetimes.
tokens: one machine, not reproduced by us
concepts.note: The unit lists a linked-but-disabled case for Diagnostics; that case belongs to the Inspector benchmark (cna_inspector_benchmark), the Diagnostics benchmark measures OFF/STATS/FULL builds.

issues.text: No workflow or preset sets CNA_DIAGNOSTICS above OFF, so STATS/FULL tests never compile in CI.
